title: The Owner of the Throne
html:
Kim Yushin's stigma, ‘Great Hwarang Assembly,’ was a technique that summoned the ‘Yonghwa Hyangdo,’ the elite hwarang who had died throughout history.

GRAAAAAAH!

Put simply, this was a land-based version of the ‘Ghost Fleet’ Lee Jihye had used.

In sheer power, it was no match for the Duke of Loyalty and Warfare's, but it was still one of the finest stigmas among the techniques Historical-grade constellations used against armies.

“Go!”

The Yonghwa Hyangdo, whose bones should long since have crumbled into dust and vanished, rose as one with their weapons raised toward the Baekje army. Some hwarang had no eyes; others were missing arms or legs.

It was cruel.

As long as Kim Yushin was here, they would take up their swords and rise, again and again. Even after their souls wore away, their anger faded to nothing, and their hearts themselves were worn down.

The soldiers who had fought to prevent their country's ruin.

Now fought for a country already ruined.

“You are as cowardly as ever, Kim Yushin! Now you even drive your dead men into battle!”

“······.”

“Come at me! If you call yourself a general, face me one-on-one!”

Despite Gyebaek's provocation, I remained still. Because Kim Yushin did not want to move. Gyebaek smashed through the Yonghwa Hyangdo with overwhelming force. Magic streaming from his enormous sword mercilessly embroidered the air.

CRUNCH! CR-CR-CRUNCH!

“Kim Yushin―!”

As that fearsome cry thundered through the air, even the emotionless ranks of the Yonghwa Hyangdo faltered.

That was Gyebaek.

Baekje's last great general, Gyebaek.

In terms of physical buffing abilities alone, Gyebaek surpassed Kim Yushin. In fact, Gyebaek had never fought Kim Yushin one-on-one in the ‘Battle of Hwangsanbeol.’

More precisely, it would be fair to say that Kim Yushin had avoided the duel.

[The character ‘Chu Wangin’ activates ‘Fight to the Death Lv.2’!]

In history, Gyebaek's detachment had resisted Kim Yushin's army, which outnumbered them ten to one, winning again and again on an impossible battlefield.

Although Kim Yushin had ultimately been the victor, Gyebaek had not lost a single battle until the final act at Hwangsanbeol began.

A battle fanatic driven by patriotism bordering on madness and a grim resolve.

Though I now had Kim Yushin's blessing behind me, under different circumstances I might have summoned Gyebaek instead of Kim Yushin.

Unable to watch any longer, Gwanchang's incarnation shouted.

“General-nim!”

“Do not move.”

Kim Yushin spoke through my mouth. Watching the ranks of the Yonghwa Hyangdo die, without the slightest change in his expression.

Kim Yushin's boundlessly tranquil state of mind came through to me exactly as it was.

Gyebaek shouted.

“Even becoming a constellation has not changed your cowardice!”

He was right. Kim Yushin was a coward.

He feared death, and he was afraid of defeat.

That was why he was strong.

He did not act rashly or let emotions sweep him away.

He disposed of enemies he could defeat, using methods that guaranteed victory.

That was how, despite losing four times, he had won the final battle at Hwangsanbeol.

“KRAAAAAAGH!”

Gyebaek's desperate struggle against hundreds of Yonghwa Hyangdo was harrowing. His incarnation's wounds were now too severe for him to survive. His whole body was drenched in blood, with fatal wounds in his thigh, both arms, and his side.

Yet he stubbornly cut down the Yonghwa Hyangdo, advancing toward me one step at a time.

“Kim······ Yu······ shin!”

[Activating the stigma ‘Request Reinforcements’!]

Ghost soldiers appeared like shadows behind Kim Yushin and thrust their spears at Gyebaek. Judging by their different uniforms, they probably were not Silla soldiers.

Perhaps they were the Tang reinforcements he was said to have summoned when he destroyed Goguryeo.

Just like Kim Yushin. Victory was all that mattered to him. Whether he borrowed the strength of a foreign power probably meant little.

THUUUNK!

The sound of countless spears piercing a chest.

Unable to withstand the pain, Gyebaek's incarnation fell to his knees.

“Kugh······!”

Even Gyebaek's incarnation, who had been so strong, had now reached his limit.

Gyebaek smiled.

“······How bitter. Even on a false stage like this, can I not reach you? I wished to cross swords with you, if only once.”

Seeing the reddened eyes of Gyebaek's incarnation left me with mixed feelings.

Gwanchang had lived, and history had changed.

But there was also history that remained unchanged, like this.

Kim Yushin asked.

“Gyebaek. Why did you do this?”

“······.”

“If you die in that state, you will be unable to choose an incarnation for some time. Why have you suddenly given up on building your myth?”

With a fierce look in his eyes, Gyebaek merely gave an inscrutable smile.

After waiting, Kim Yushin drew his sword.

I hurriedly wrested back control of my voice.

“You must not kill him with my hands.”

[Why?]

“······I have a restriction.”

The King of No Killing must not kill directly.

Because killing even a single member of his own kind with his own hands would strip him of his kingship.

Kim Yushin nodded as though he understood.

[······I see. I have a rough idea of what it is. Do not worry. I give you my word on the honor of the stars. It is not you who will behead Gyebaek now, but I, Kim Yushin.]

“But······.”

[······If it troubles you that much, very well.]

When Kim Yushin gestured, one of the Yonghwa Hyangdo who had risen from the ground nodded.

I handed my voice over to Kim Yushin.

“Gyebaek, let us meet in the next world.”

Gyebaek's incarnation looked up at us in silence. He seemed about to say something, but in the end he could not open his mouth. In that final moment, his face looked less like Gyebaek's than that of a bit-part actor who had simply finished his entire performance.

And the incarnation's head flew silently through the air.

[「Stage Transformation― Hwangsanbeol」 ends.]

[You have relived (追體驗) the ‘Battle of Hwangsanbeol’.]

[You receive 1000 coins as an experience reward.]

Looking around, I saw that the entire Baekje army had been annihilated.

[Taking the indirect nature of the killings into account, the authority of the ‘King of No Killing’ is maintained.]

What a relief.

Because the King of No Killing was stripped of his title only when he killed someone with his own hands.

The lives taken by the Yonghwa Hyangdo did not count as his killings.

“Representative-nim! Are you all right?”

Lee Sungkook's voice came through the dust.

Yoo Sangah was sighing in relief, while Lee Gilyoung looked disgruntled, perhaps because he had not gotten to do much. And Min Jiwon.

“What on earth was that just now······?”

Looked utterly dazed.

I shrugged and said.

“If you want to become a king, you should start by studying some history.”

Although I had summoned Kim Yushin, I was not particularly on either Silla's side or Baekje's.

I had merely summoned him because he was the right choice for dealing with Gyebaek.

In any case, I was glad the result was better than expected.

I had thoroughly tested the capabilities of the [Ganpyeongui], and above all, I had been able to collect the coins and some of the items the Baekje army had carried.

[You have acquired 5400 coins.]

[Coins Held : 74950 C]

Now, even if the fourth scenario's final phase arrived, it wouldn't frighten me much.

“We don't have time, so let's head north right away.”

[The blessing has 3 minutes remaining.]

Kim Yushin's blessing was still in effect.

Since I had already used the [Ganpyeongui], I needed to make every bit of the remaining time count.

It was an item I could use only seven times. Surely I ought to squeeze everything I could out of it.

“Rise, Yonghwa Hyangdo!”

As the shattered ranks of the Yonghwa Hyangdo rose again, I pointed my sword north.

“Advance!”

The enormous expenditure of magic meant there was little time left to keep the Yonghwa Hyangdo active. Awakened from the earth, their ranks began marching north, indiscriminately sweeping away small and medium-sized groups.

At this rate, it might even be possible to sweep away all the other kings' forces gathered near the palace museum.

Screams erupted here and there among the factions brawling along the main road.

“What the hell are these skeleton bastards! Waaaagh!”

THUD! CR-CRUNCH!

The incarnations charging at me were crushed by the Yonghwa Hyangdo's attacks.

Since I wasn't the one attacking anyway, I wouldn't receive a penalty even if they were accidentally killed.

Yes, this was what it took to feel some satisfaction.

Kim Yushin's True Voice sounded in my head.

[There is something strange about you. To remain sane even after hearing my True Voice······.]

“I have a fairly strong mind.”

I offered that as an excuse, but the truth was that I was a little surprised myself.

There was a reason constellations used ‘indirect messages’ to communicate.

Even though Kim Yushin was a Historical-grade constellation with a relatively low Status among constellations, simply hearing his True Voice would normally be enough to make someone piss and shit their pants or pass out.

In fact, I had been a little worried about that myself······.

[Remember, you owe me a great debt. To help you, I had to shoulder more probability than necessary.]

There was something ominous in his tone.

I hurried to express my gratitude.

“I'm grateful for that. Your help will not be forgotten for generations, General-nim.”

[An impetuous fellow. You do not even seem to have anyone to carry your line into the next generation (代) yet······.]

“······Won't I have one someday? If I have children, I will make sure to pass down what happened today.”

[More to the point, you appear to have no constellation sponsor.]

My ominous hunch had been right.

Damn it. I'd been wondering why this old fox kept talking to me.

[I like you. If you are willing, I would like to become your constellation sponsor in this world and travel the world with you.]

He made it sound grand, but that was just a long-winded way of saying he wanted to use me as his slave in this world.

“I'm afraid I can't do that.”

[Why? Surely you have seen enough of my power? With my stigmas, you could become the strongest of this age.]

I admitted that [Great Hwarang Assembly] was a good stigma.

But historians (史家) did not call Kim Yushin a ‘fox’ for nothing.

The strongest of this age?

Even a scam ought to have some limits.

For a Historical-grade constellation to say such a thing—if the Great Sage, Heaven's Equal had heard it, he would have plucked out about ten hairs.

“This isn't the Three Kingdoms era anymore, sir. You're getting on in years, so please go home and rest.”

It had been a pleasure. Now let's never see each other again.

[The constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ snickers at the ‘King Heungmu the Great’.]

[You have received 300 coins in sponsorship.]

Kim Yushin was silent for a while, perhaps because his pride had been wounded.

I was hoping he would withdraw quietly like this when a sharp pain suddenly shot through my head.

[You have not forgotten that my blessing is still in effect, have you?]

At present, Kim Yushin and I were connected through the [Ganpyeongui].

Muscles throughout my body began to spasm. The signs were unsettling.

No, even so, surely a great historical figure of Korea wouldn't······?

No. Being a great historical figure of Korea, he just might.

Damn it.

[You would do well to reconsider.]

Yoo Sangah looked at me with apparent concern.

“Dokja-ssi?”

“Yoo Sangah-ssi. Get away from me. Quickly!”

My trembling right hand drew ‘Unbreakable Faith’ of its own accord and began pointing it toward Yoo Sangah.

Kim Yushin had begun forcibly controlling my body.

[You said there was a restriction on killing, did you not? I wonder what sort of restriction it is. May I kill that woman now to find out?]

“Kim Yushin, this is your will. It won't count toward my karma.”

[Heh heh, who can say? What if I withdraw my blessing the instant the blade pierces her? Wouldn't that count as your killing even then? And from what I can see, that woman seems quite precious to you, doesn't she?]

“······Stop this.”

[Promise me. Promise that you will choose me, Kim Yushin, at the next ‘Sponsor Selection.’]

This old fox's intentions were clear.

Once the fourth scenario ended, another <Sponsor Selection> would open.

Kim Yushin intended to take advantage of having made contact with me to extract an oath.

If I had not read ‘Ways of Survival,’ it would not have been a bad choice.

Kim Yushin was a reasonably decent constellation, and ‘Great Hwarang Assembly’ alone would let me get through the scenarios without much trouble until their middle stages.

But if I had intended to choose a sponsor and proceed that way, I would have picked the Great Sage, Heaven's Equal from the start. Why choose Kim Yushin now?

“I said no.”

Besides, my contract with Bihyung meant I could not choose a constellation sponsor anyway.

Kim Yushin's voice hardened.

[A young man with considerable spirit. But that is the wrong choice. Let us see how long you can hold out.]

The hand gripping the sword hilt finally began moving toward Yoo Sangah.

“Yoo Sangah-ssi, hurry······!”

But Yoo Sangah had frozen at the sudden turn of events.

Watching my right hand move of its own accord, I finally had to make a decision.

Damn it. I showed him respect as a great historical figure, and now this old bastard really······.

I steadied my breathing.

This was my body.

Constellations or whatever you were, I would never hand it over to you bastards.

[The exclusive skill ‘Fourth Wall’ activates!]

The pages of ‘Ways of Survival’ turned in my head.

With a rumbling sound, light surged through my head, and radiant strings of characters began arranging themselves. They were the text of ‘Ways of Survival.’

[Huh······?]

Kim Yushin noticed something and cried out in shock almost at the exact moment his presence began rapidly fading.

As expected, the old fox was quick on the uptake.

[The constellation's blessing connected through ‘Echo of the Stars’ disappears.]

At the last moment, Kim Yushin's shocked True Voice echoed.

[Just what are you······?]

And Kim Yushin's presence vanished completely.

Honestly, I was surprised too.

I had expected it to be possible with [Fourth Wall], but to think I could sever the connection to a constellation linked through the [Ganpyeongui] so easily.

What had happened in the ‘Theatre Dungeon’ last time had given me the hint. Back then, the ‘Theatre Master,’ who had tried to look inside my head, had also vanished the moment it faced [Fourth Wall].

I had hoped I might be able to send a constellation to its grave the same way, but unfortunately, it seemed the quick-witted Kim Yushin had fled first.

[The constellation ‘King Heungmu the Great’ harbors doubts about your existence.]

[The constellation ‘King Heungmu the Great’ will watch you closely from now on.]

That old man and his grudges.

“······Are you all right now?”

“Yes. I'm all right. But······.”

What was this now?

When I came to my senses, I found my limbs tightly bound with magical threads. I looked something like a chrysalis. Her face flushed red, Yoo Sangah fumbled for an explanation.

“Well······I couldn't just leave you and run, but if I stayed beside you, I thought I'd be attacked.”

I thought I understood what had happened.

To think she had used [Thread Binding] on me in that brief interval.

I had thought she was frozen in shock, but she had actually been using a skill.

“You have remarkable reflexes.”

“······I'm sorry.”

“That was a compliment. If I start doing something stupid again, please do this to me just as you did now.”

“I-I'll untie you right away!”

Yoo Sangah looked flustered, but I meant it. Perhaps I had been mistaken to think she would remain an ordinary ‘office worker’ forever.

Looking back, I saw that Min Jiwon, the King of Beauty, was glancing between Yoo Sangah and me with a peculiar look in her eyes.

“Well······I'll be going now. I came to help, but I ended up being the one who received help.”

I nodded.

“The next time we meet, we'll be enemies.”

“······Aren't we on the same side now? In dramas, this is usually how people become friends.”

“That's a drama.”

“Be faithful in friendship! Make friends through trust. That's the principle of our hwarang.”

With those words, Min Jiwon moved away, receding with a smile that made it hard to tell how much she truly meant.

Could the King of Beauty in this round become a good king?

I did not know.

The King of Beauty herself probably did not really know either.

“Let's get going too. Lee Sungkook-ssi! Come out now.”

At my shout, Lee Sungkook sheepishly emerged from behind the building where he had been hiding with Lee Gilyoung in his grasp.

This bastard had boldly declared he would stop Gyebaek. When had he hidden himself over there?

I began heading north with my companions.

Everywhere Kim Yushin's ‘Great Hwarang Assembly’ had swept through lay in ruins.

The minor kings who had been brawling lay scattered along the main road like discarded rags, the backs of their skulls smashed. This must be the might of a proper constellation. Kim Yushin was cowardly, but he was useful.

I picked up the free flags lying around one by one, steadily increasing my achievement points.

[Your ‘Brown Flag’ absorbs the accumulated achievement points of a ‘Brown Flag’.]

[Your ‘Brown Flag’ evolves into a ‘Purple Flag’.]

[You can now use the privileges of the ‘Purple Flag’.]

As expected, the best way to grow stronger was without fighting.

Looking around, I found that most of the flags had already been collected.

From purple onward, a flag's achievement points did not rise easily.

In other words, taking down run-of-the-mill ‘kings’ would be useless from this point on.

“Jung Minseob-ssi, are you there?”

The next moment, Jung Minseob's figure appeared out of thin air.

The [Hermit's Cloak] I had given him earlier covered his body.

Jung Minseob had been assigned to scout the palace museum for this mission.

“How many have gone in so far?”

“A total of nine kings have entered, including the Tyrant and the True Reader.”

Nine. A reasonable number.

“What kinds of flags?”

“Seven purple and two brown. Of those with purple flags, two had particularly deep colors.”

“That would be the Tyrant and the True Reader.”

“That's right.”

Jung Minseob—this guy was more useful than I'd expected, huh?

I spoke.

“This time, only Yoo Sangah-ssi, Gilyoung, and I will go in. The other two of you should keep waiting outside. You can hide under the cloak as well.”

“······Will that be all right?”

“Yes. We only need three people right now anyway.”

“Call us anytime, and we'll come in.”

I appreciated the sentiment, but here they would only get in the way.

Because, if what I knew was correct, the Seoul Palace Museum was now a [Dungeon].

[A new hidden scenario has arrived!]

●

<Hidden Scenario ― Relics of Trials>

Category : Hidden

Difficulty : F~A+

Clear Conditions : Clear a ‘Relic Dungeon’ appropriate to the number of participants.

Time Limit : None

Reward : 500~5000 coins

Failure : Death

●

The moment we entered the museum, a pristine white marble lobby unfolded before our eyes. There was no sign of anyone in it.

Yoo Sangah spoke in a tense voice.

“I'm too scared to enjoy cultural outings anymore. First it was a movie theater, and now even a museum······.”

“Hyung, are we here to get that legendary sword or whatever it was too?”

“No, not right now.”

Of course, the ‘Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword’ could also be found inside this dungeon.

After all, I was the one who had spread that information.

[Select the type of dungeon you wish to enter.]

●1-Person Dungeon ― Chamber of the Nagak (螺角)

●3-Person Dungeon ― Chamber of the Acupuncture Copper Man (鍼灸銅人)

●5-Person Dungeon ― Chamber of the Donguibogam (東醫寶鑑)

●7-Person Dungeon ― Chamber of the Dragon Jar (龍樽)

But the dungeon containing the ‘Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword’ could not be entered by ordinary means. It was a dungeon considered hidden even within this hidden scenario, accessible only by collecting the ‘Sang Pyong Tong Bo (常平通寶)’ awarded for clearing each dungeon.

“I choose the three-person dungeon, the Chamber of the Acupuncture Copper Man.”

[Entering the 3-person dungeon.]

Lee Gilyoung looked a little disappointed.

Well, he must have been looking forward to getting some amazing relic.

“Gilyoung. There's more to a relic than how it looks.”

“······Huh?”

“Things that look flashy often don't have much substance.”

The Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword was one of those overhyped items.

The truly good things here were the ones obtainable from the dungeons you could enter normally.

The skill available in the three-person dungeon, the ‘Chamber of the Acupuncture Copper Man,’ was one of them.

The moment we entered the dungeon, Yoo Sangah spoke in surprise.

“······It looks like other people have come in besides us.”

Indeed, intermittent screams could be heard throughout the dungeon.

“Waaaagh! Get away!”

A monster shaped like a human, with a matte black surface.

Such black copper men (銅人) packed the three-person dungeon.

Grade-7 replicating species (複製種), Acupuncture Copper Man.

These monsters replicated themselves after a certain amount of time, and at present, the method of defeating them was not well known. Acupuncture Copper Men had tough bodies and no internal organs, and with no nervous system, they felt no pain.

“Aaaaagh! Help me!”

Some incarnations clumsily slashed the copper men with their swords, but the copper men merely leaked a little mercury and suffered no significant damage. Instead, they strode forward and pulled a man's body taut.

RRRIIIP!

The body of the man, whose Constitution, Strength, and Agility appeared close to 50, was torn apart like paper in an Acupuncture Copper Man's grasp.

“······Dokja-ssi, how do we fight these things? They aren't taking any damage.”

Yoo Sangah and Lee Gilyoung were also vigorously swinging blunt weapons and using skills against the approaching Acupuncture Copper Men, but with little effect.

Occasionally, Lee Gilyoung's blunt weapon did damage an Acupuncture Copper Man, but he did not seem to understand how he had hurt it.

“Look closely at their bodies.”

Every type of monster appearing in the ‘Relics of Trials’ scenario was modeled after a relic in the [Seoul Palace Museum].

For instance, the Nagak in the one-person dungeon was literally an instrument made from a conch shell, and the Donguibogam in the five-person dungeon······well, that one hardly needed an explanation. The point was that the Acupuncture Copper Men in the three-person dungeon were no different.

After staring at a copper man for some time, Yoo Sangah was the first to speak.

“There's something engraved on its body.”

“That's right.”

In fact, the Acupuncture Copper Man (鍼灸銅人) was a relic used to mark the 354 acupuncture points (經穴) throughout the human body: the front, back, arms, legs, and head.

In other words, this relic was a teaching aid for traditional Korean medicine during the Joseon era.

[‘Blade of Faith’ activates!]

I activated the blade and stabbed one of the Acupuncture Copper Man's acupuncture points.

The copper man writhed in pain, then crumbled into powder with a rustling crackle.

An anticlimactic end for a replicating species as high as grade 7.

[You have slain your first Acupuncture Copper Man!]

“If you look closely, each acupuncture point has a slightly different color. Some are paralysis points, some are death points. And some are muteness points······Each Acupuncture Copper Man is designed to produce a different effect depending on which point you stab.”

“Ah······!”

The key was to find those tiny acupuncture points and block or cut off their flow.

After I demonstrated a few times, Lee Gilyoung and Yoo Sangah quickly got the hang of it.

Lee Gilyoung chose to use [Diverse Communication] to have small insects strike the points, while Yoo Sangah adapted [Thread Binding], inserting threads like tiny needles. Watching the copper men shudder once and collapse where they stood, I was honestly impressed.

Both of them were growing at a truly excellent pace.

[Your party is the first to slay 100 Acupuncture Copper Men!]

[You have cleared the 3-person dungeon.]

[You have each acquired 4 Sang Pyong Tong Bo as the basic reward.]

[You have acquired the exclusive skill ‘Pressure Point Strike (點穴)’ as a special reward.]

We had obtained the skill I was aiming for too.

Pressure Point Strike (點穴).

A technique unique to returnees from martial arts worlds, which subdued enemies by suppressing specific pressure points.

It was an essential skill for me, since I needed to maintain the ‘King of No Killing’ for the time being.

Yoo Sangah murmured as she looked curiously at the Sang Pyong Tong Bo she had received.

“Can we buy something with these?”

“They're items you can exchange for coins or use as dungeon entry tickets.”

“Then······.”

“Of course, we'll be using them as entry tickets. Now, each of you hand over three. I'll put in four, so let's make ten altogether.”

“Ten? Wait, Dokja-ssi, don't tell me······?”

“We're going to enter the hidden dungeon where you can obtain the ‘Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword.’”

Yoo Sangah asked in surprise.

“But didn't you say we weren't going to get the Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword?”

I slowly shook my head.

“We're not going there to get the ‘Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword.’”

We were going to ‘hunt’ the kings who had gone there to get it.

We would enter the dungeon, but we were not going to get the Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword.

Both Yoo Sangah and Lee Gilyoung immediately understood what that meant.

“You mean we're going to take their flags.”

“Then we can kill them all from now on.”

In different senses, of course.

Yoo Sangah looked down at Lee Gilyoung in surprise. What was interesting was that Lee Gilyoung looked up at Yoo Sangah with disappointment in his eyes.

“Hyung, leave finishing them off to me.”

This kid had even······already noticed that I did not take human lives myself.

[Activating the exclusive skill ‘Character List’.]

[This person is not registered in ‘Character List’.]

[Information on this person is currently being collected.]

I still could not see Lee Gilyoung's information.

When I turned my head, I met Yoo Sangah's worried gaze. She looked between Lee Gilyoung and me, then lowered her head. I said to Lee Gilyoung.

“Do as you like.”

I understood what Yoo Sangah was worried about. Lee Gilyoung was not even old enough for middle school yet. But she too would have had some inkling.

In this world, the morality we had known was no longer useful.

“But this isn't a game. You have to be careful.”

“Yes, don't worry.”

Listening to Lee Gilyoung's confident voice, I hid the flag I'd been carrying on my back beneath my clothes.

Until now, the flag had been good bait for luring lousy kings, but from now on it would become the scent of blood that drew predators.

On a battlefield where I was going to hunt kings, nothing good would come of revealing that I was a king myself.

The intermediate dokkaebi's voice sounded out of the air.

[Heh heh, you're all doing very well! With so many people carrying out a ‘hidden scenario,’ ‘hidden’ hardly means anything anymore, does it?]

How shameless.

Sometimes I thought it must be hard to be that sly.

[Someone has already met the requirements for the ‘First Qualification,’ too. Yes, this is what makes it fun.]

It seemed a king had already obtained a [Black Flag].

Probably one of the Seven Kings.

[The requirements for the ‘Second Qualification’ will also be revealed shortly, so please look forward to it.]

I turned to my companions and said.

“Let's hurry. A dokkaebi's ‘shortly’ is longer than you'd think.”

I fitted the Sang Pyong Tong Bo we had collected into the holes at the lobby entrance, one by one.

[You can enter a hidden chamber (場) by using 10 Sang Pyong Tong Bo.]

[Would you like to enter the hidden chamber, the ‘Chamber of the Big Dipper’?]

The flag I currently had was a [Purple Flag].

All the kings with flags of the same purple grade would be gathered in the ‘Chamber of the Big Dipper.’

In other words, all my prey were now gathered in one place.

[You have entered the ‘Chamber of the Big Dipper’.]

My vision rippled, and the scene in the lobby changed. The pristine white marble lobby became a spacious, open waiting room.

At the far end of the waiting room were seven doors.

“Ugh······.”

Yoo Sangah gave a brief groan and took a step back. A human corpse lay at her feet. The bodies of group members who had fought a faction battle. Lee Gilyoung quietly looked down at the corpse with an expressionless face.

There were so many corpses that it was impossible to walk without obstruction. Easily hundreds of bodies lay piled like burial mounds here and there.

It seemed a storm of blood had already swept through.

I was starting to feel strange.

If I had not spread that plagiarist bastard's text file, these people might not have died.

Then had they ultimately died because of me?

“There are people over there.”

In the center of the waiting room, an enormous bonfire burned, fueled by human corpses.

I could see the faces of survivors talking quietly among themselves. I did not know whether they were remnants of defeated forces or observing a truce, but they were not fighting.

Watching the groups, I spoke to my companions.

“Be careful.”

The groups quietly getting to their feet.

Greed showed in the eyes of the people approaching us.

“Newcomers, huh? Who's your king?”

While someone drew our attention with his words, others stealthily moved in behind our party. The encirclement kept tightening.

“Is it you? Or the woman beside you? It can't be this little kid······.”

[A considerable number of constellations find this petty interference tiresome.]

[Some constellations want you to begin taking action in earnest.]

I was already planning to.

“Hey, why aren't you answering······Aagh!”
